data.body: UPDATE TO PRIOR COMMENT: the detected_by classification field referenced in the earlier coordination comment (originally story cf65-e3b4-0bea-4756) has been rolled into the new Calibration Program Observability epic a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3. 69e8's graduation phase will be able to use detected_by tags as a candidate-weighting signal once the observability epic ships.
